knowledge_point.title: Determining the Inverse of a Larger Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Using the method of direct verification, determine whether the matrix $B$ is the inverse of $A,$ where

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix},\,B=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}.
$$

- **I.** $B=A^{-1}$

Select the statement if it is true. Leave the box unchecked otherwise.
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we check whether $AB = BA = I_3.$

Computing $AB$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\ & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\ & ={I}_{3}.\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Likewise, computing $BA$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}BA & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\ & =\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\ & ={I}_{3}.\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $B=A^{-1}.$
